name: Siemens Energy AG
blurb: Siemens Energy AG is a global energy technology company spun off from Siemens AG in September 2020 and headquartered in Munich, Germany. The company operates across power generation (gas turbines, steam turbines, compressors), energy transmission (transformers, switchgear, HVDC), and renewable energy through its majority-owned subsidiary Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy. It serves utilities, industrial customers, and oil & gas operators across more than 90 countries. By revenue it ranks among the largest energy technology companies in the world, with its grid technology and electrification businesses positioned as key beneficiaries of global energy-transition infrastructure investment.
